# Dear ImGui 1.91.9 (MIT)

From https://github.com/ocornut/imgui, tag `v1.91.9`: the core sources and the Vulkan back end, unmodified
(`LICENSE.txt`). Used by the settings overlay (runtime/src/overlay.cpp), which feeds it input itself and records it in
the present pass; the platform back ends are not needed. To update, copy the same files from a newer tag.
